reviews.name: John G.
reviews.text: I was looking for a company to power wash my home so I put out a recommendation request on one of my community groups on Facebook. Mike Costello responded promptly and was able to give me an estimate very quickly using software that would measure the house. I especially liked this feature as I'm busy and I was not required to waste time and meet him for an appointment. He delivered me a quote electronically within the hour also via software I was very impressed by. The price I thought was very reasonable and because of how quickly and efficiently he got it to me, I didn't even look for more quotes. I later negotiated with him an additional price to do my wrap around deck. When I returned home that evening I was expecting the house to be clean but what I got was far more than I expected. My house looks brand new. I was actually considering changing my siding but now I think I can hold off for a few years because this has given it a tremendous face lift. I strongly advise anyone looking for a professional, reasonably priced, timely company to give Mike a shot. He won't disappoint.
